offer.text: My brother lives here in the village, but we've quarreled and I'm too proud to go myself. Carry this letter to him — hold it in hand and give it to him directly.

accept.text: Thank you. He'll know my seal the moment he sees it.

decline.text: Perhaps I'll find another runner, then.

in_progress.text: Have you found my brother yet? He's never far from home.

ready.text: He has the letter? Truly? Bless you.

complete.text: Family is everything, in the end. My thanks — take this for your trouble.
